items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the canonical morphism K -> RSheafHom(L, K tensor^L L) on the derived category of a ringed site (statement lines 9086-9094). The construction again hinges on resolution choices: K must be represented by a K-flat complex so that the total tensor product represents K tensor^L L, and that total tensor product must be replaced by a K-injective J^bullet so that the internal hom into it computes the derived internal hom (proof lines 9097-9102). With those choices the morphism is the composite of the diagonal map and the map induced by the quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 9102-9110). The claim is H2: one construction whose content is the recognition of the two represented objects, exactly as in the companion lemmas of the same section.
